author: Allen
name: OT Lab - Suricata OT signature fired
description: One of the lab's custom Suricata OT rules (SID 9000001-9000999) fired. Signature names and ATT&CK-ICS technique are in the alert metadata.
query: event.kind: alert and suricata.eve.alert.signature_id >= 9000001 and suricata.eve.alert.signature_id <= 9000999
note: Pivot on `suricata.eve.alert.signature` and `suricata.eve.alert.metadata` for the ICS technique. Use `network.community_id` to jump to the matching Zeek conn record.
